_meta._note: Lives in config/app/ (ADR 0001 3.10.1, D-062): telemetry measures the game; no value here changes a reward, the movement gate, combat, or the economy. Full key names are app.telemetry.<path>. Bucket bounds follow the economy scale in config/balance/economy.json (read only as a reference, never merged) so a bucket stays meaningful when prices are tuned; retune them together

sampling._assumption: A-P1-X04-4: emptyScreenAbandonTimeout_s 120 = the '60+' bucket keeps a real range (60-120 s); a player who stays longer than 2 min on the fallback screen without pressing anything is counted as reading, not abandoning. Owner: product-manager

timestamps._source: product/telemetry-events.md 1 envelope (server_ts wins when client_ts and server_ts differ by more than this)
timestamps._note: Skew is measured once per upload batch (client send time vs server receive time), not per event: events ride on the trace batch (telemetry-events.md 8.2) and may be up to balance.dungeons.offlineEvidence.maxOfflineEvidenceAge_s old by design. Only the per-batch offset above the tolerance makes the server rewrite client_ts. Telemetry timestamps never feed the movement gate, which uses server-side checks only
timestamps._assumption: A-P1-X04-5: 120 s covers normal phone clock drift and mobile network latency. Owner: backend-programmer, product-manager

goldAmountBuckets._source: product/telemetry-events.md 5 economy_gold_earned / economy_gold_spent amount_bucket; scale from config/balance/economy.json (npcSellPrice_gold 20-900, potions 150-2500, gddReferenceEconomy.incomePerWalkingHour_gold 1470, marketTax brackets up to 150000)
goldAmountBuckets._note: Bucket i covers (upperBounds_gold[i-1], upperBounds_gold[i]]; the first covers [0, 50]; amounts above the last bound go to '150000+'. Labels: 0-50, 50-200, 200-500, 500-1500, 1500-5000, 5000-20000, 20000-60000, 60000-150000, 150000+. 50 ~ one dust sale, 200 ~ one core sale or small potion, 500-1500 ~ one walking hour, 20000 / 60000 / 150000 match the market tax bracket edges so tax behaviour can be read from the buckets
